name: Seat picker
summary: A cinema or concert seat map: the film's poster and showtime, the screen at the top, price rows of seats that are free, taken, yours, recliners or wheelchair spaces, a key, and the seats you picked with their total and Continue.
use: in a cinema, theatre or concert booking flow, for choosing seats
a11y: Every seat is a native checkbox named with its row, number, kind and price (taken seats are disabled), rows are labelled groups, the total is announced as it changes, and on a small touch screen the map scrolls sideways inside its own box.

use_when: a seated venue with a few price bands and accessible spaces, where people pick exact seats for one showing
avoid_when: a plane, train or stadium seat map: every row here is a fixed cinema row of 10 seats in blocks of 2, 6 and 2
general admission with ticket counts only: use event-ticket or order-summary
choosing a date or showtime before seats: use date-range-picker or calendar-agenda

parts.name: title
parts.what: the film or show, the section heading

parts.name: tags
parts.what: genre, length and rating on one line

parts.name: facts
parts.what: venue and showtime, each after an icon

parts.name: screen
parts.what: the curved screen line at the top of the map

parts.name: tiers
parts.what: a price band heading above its rows

parts.name: rows
parts.what: one row of 10 seats in blocks of 2, 6 and 2, with its letter

parts.name: seats
parts.what: one seat checkbox: free, taken, yours, recliner or wheelchair space

parts.name: picked
parts.what: how many seats, which ones, and the total, announced as it changes

parts.name: continue
parts.what: the Continue button, disabled with no seats picked

empty.how: with no seats picked the summary reads 'Pick up to 8 seats', the total is zero and Continue is disabled

loading.how: keep the header and screen line and draw each row as muted seat outlines with every checkbox disabled until the map loads

error.how: if a picked seat is taken before Continue, uncheck it, disable it and put an alert-banners line above the summary

disabled.how: taken seats are disabled, filled grey with a cross, and skipped by Tab; Continue is disabled with none picked

overflow.how: on a small screen the aisles narrow and the map scrolls sideways in its own box

long_text.how: the title balances its lines and the info column shrinks beside the poster; seat labels are numbers only

keyboard: Tab reaches the seat map, then each free seat in row order, skipping taken ones, then Continue
With the seat map focused, the arrow keys scroll it sideways when it is wider than its box
Space picks or unpicks the focused seat; a ninth pick is undone
Enter or Space presses Continue once a seat is picked
